title: The Gap, Brisbane QLD 4061

anchor.description: Model centre (coordinate origin); chosen at the midpoint of OSM way 30657925

frame: three.js: x = easting - anchor, y = AHD - base_z, z = -(northing - anchor)

terrain.note: uint16 little-endian, row 0 = north edge, value*scale + zmin = m AHD

alignment.note: OSM here was traced from GDA94-era imagery and sits ~1.5 m SW of the 2019 LiDAR, DTM and aerial photo (all GDA2020). Shifting OSM by the GDA94->GDA2020 difference raises its overlap with LiDAR roofs from IoU 0.38 to 0.42; Microsoft footprints and imagery need no shift.
